result.summary: This pull request adds three test cases to `test/functional/mempool_accept.py` covering nonstandard Taproot witness spends. It verifies that transactions with an annex, an oversized tapscript stack element (>80 bytes), or an empty control block fail mempool acceptance with the specific reject reason `bad-witness-nonstandard`.
result.problem: Existing functional tests like `feature_taproot.py` exercise Taproot standardness rules but check rejection only via generic RPC error codes rather than asserting the exact `bad-witness-nonstandard` reject reason.
